summary: GLM-5.3-Flash Spark TP2 serves eight requests with 1.15M KV tokens; 16 slots selectable
compatibility: Applies to PRESET=glm53-spark-tp2. MAX_NUM_SEQS=16 or CACHE_MODE=lmcache lower the preset KV size automatically; an explicit KV_CACHE_MEMORY_BYTES is used as given. The embedding table needs about 0.6 GiB of pinned host RAM per GPU.
details: Eight request slots (was four) and 4,557 MiB of KV per rank: about 1.15M tokens (was 998K). The input embedding table lives in host RAM, the vision tower runs in MXFP8 and TP, DCP and EP share one NCCL communicator.
Sixteen slots keep 4,045 MiB (about 1.02M tokens). With LMCache: 1.0M tokens at eight slots, 0.86M at sixteen.

Every combination passed a worst-case mixed load of 62K-token prompts, 4K images, six-image requests and decoding streams with at least 0.24 GiB free at the peak; the previous preset had 27 MiB free under the same load.
Decode speed is unchanged (C1 69 steps/s); long prefills are 1-3% slower.
